feed_type: SAP SuccessFactors RMK (jobs2web) HTML search — scraped, no public JSON. Secondary portal: Avature with a real JSON endpoint.
how_to_query: TWO separate live portals, two different entities. (1) DELOITTE INDIA (Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP / Deloitte South Asia LLP / Deloitte Shared Services India LLP / Deloitte Haskins & Sells CA LLP) — https://southasiacareers.deloitte.com DNS: southasiacareers.deloitte.com -> deloitteindia.jobs2web.com -> rmk44.jobs2web.com = SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Marketing. No JSON API exposed; grepping for /api/, .json, myworkdayjobs, taleo, avature, icims, smartrecruiters, eightfold, phenom returned only "successfactors". Scrape the HTML: GET /search/?q=&sortColumn=referencedate&sortDirection=desc&startrow= (25 rows/page) Parse rows with: ... TITLE ... LOC ... DATE Total = the aria-label on #searchresults ("Page 1 of 82, Results 1 to 25 of 2032"). Full board walked in 82 requests. GOTCHA: job detail pages validate the slug. /job/x// returns 200 but renders "Sorry, this position has been filled." You MUST reuse the exact slug from the listing and percent-encode it (& and , break curl). Detail page carries "Job requisition ID", "Location", "Entity" and the verbatim quals inside class="jobDisplayShell". (2) DELOITTE USI (US-India delivery arm) — https://usijobs.deloitte.com/en_US/careersUSI/ = Avature, and it DOES have JSON: GET /en_US/careersUSI/SearchJobsAJAXJSON/?jobRecordsPerPage=10&jobOffset= -> [{"id","value","label","category","location","postedDate"}]. jobRecordsPerPage is ignored (always 10); page by jobOffset. 714 jobs enumerated. Detail: /en_US/careersUSI/JobDetail// DEAD HOSTS (confirmed globally, not a local DNS issue): jobsindia.deloitte.com and careersindia.deloitte.com both return NXDOMAIN from Google Public DNS (dns.google/resolve Status:3). Deloitte's own India site still links to jobsindia.deloitte.com — that link is stale/broken.
total_india: 2,031 live postings on the Deloitte India/Sri Lanka/Mauritius board, of which ~2,008 are India-located (23 Colombo, LK; 1 unlabelled "IN"). Separately, Deloitte USI lists 714 India-located jobs (229 Hyderabad-primary, 468 "Multiple Locations", 10 Bengaluru, 3 Gurugram, 2 Pune, 1 Chennai, 1 Kolkata). Counts as at 25 Sep 2026.
total_mumbai: 277 on the Deloitte India board (261 "Mumbai, IN" + 14 "Mumbai - Commerz III" + 2 "Mumbai - I-Think"). ZERO Mumbai-primary roles on the USI board — USI Mumbai only appears as a secondary location on multi-city Tax/ERP reqs. Of the 277 Mumbai roles, the overwhelming majority are SAP/Oracle ERP, Cyber (Data Privacy / TPRM / SOC), Tax, Audit, or Assistant Manager-and-above grades. Genuine junior analytics/BI openings in Mumbai: roughly 2-4.
student_programs:
SHORT ANSWER: Deloitte India has NO 2027-batch graduate programme and NO India internship open on any live Deloitte portal right now (25 Sep 2026). This is a verified negative, not a failure to find data.

Evidence (both portals fully enumerated):
- Deloitte India board (2,031 jobs): searching the whole board for intern/internship/graduate/campus/fresher/trainee/apprentice/entry-level/student surfaced only 6 hits. TWO are interns and BOTH are Colombo, Sri Lanka ("Intern - Controls Assurance: Business Information Technology Audit", "EA - GO: Intern - Strategy & Growth"). The India hits are "Management Trainee | Risk Tech | Bhubaneswar" x2 (which is actually a PySpark/Python backend developer req) and "Associate Analyst" roles that demand 5 years' experience. Keyword search q=campus returns 10 results, none of which is a campus programme. q=fresher returns 7, all Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager tax and audit reqs.
- Deloitte USI board (714 jobs): zero intern/campus/graduate/student postings. Only false positives on "Internal Communication" and "International Tax".
- Both boards are experienced-hire boards only.

WHAT DELOITTE INDIA ACTUALLY RUNS FOR STUDENTS (and where it sits in the calendar):
1. On-campus placements. Deloitte India hires via college placement cells; Deloitte USI's own students page says only "get in touch with your campus placement team" for recruitment visit dates. Nothing on this is published on the job boards. STATUS: not a portal application — goes through DJSCE's TPO.
2. NLA (National Level Assessment) — Deloitte India's off-campus fresher drive for Analyst Trainee / Associate Analyst, open to B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA/B.Sc/BCA/BBA/B.Com etc. Third-party aggregators report the 2026-batch NLA closed 19 January 2026, at Rs 3.25-4.0 LPA with a 1-year apprenticeship probation. STATUS: CLOSED. I could NOT verify NLA on any deloitte.com domain — treat the figures as unconfirmed third-party. If the cycle repeats, the 2027-batch NLA would plausibly open around Dec 2026-Jan 2027, which lands squarely in his window. This is the single highest-value thing for him to watch.
3. Deloitte USI student initiatives, per Deloitte's own USI students page: "BRIDGE Campus Learning Series" (webinars), "Internships at Deloitte", "Be the One" (campus initiative), "Deloitte Academia Leadership Symposium", "CampusSphere at Deloitte" (one-day leadership programme). Deloitte publishes NO eligibility, batch, deadline or application link for any of these. STATUS: no open application route findable; all are campus-mediated.

IS DJSCE A TARGET CAMPUS? Probably yes, but I could not verify this on any Deloitte source. Collegedunia's DJSCE placement page lists Deloitte among recruiters that visit DJ Sanghvi, alongside EY, ZS Associates and Apollo Global (2024 drive). That is a third-party aggregator, not Deloitte and not the DJSCE TPO. He should confirm with the DJSCE placement cell directly — they will also know whether Deloitte's slot is Deloitte India (Mumbai consulting/risk) or Deloitte USI (Hyderabad/Bengaluru delivery), which is the difference that matters most for him.

PRACTICAL READ FOR A MAY-2027 GRADUATE: the experienced-hire board is the wrong door. Only one posting on either portal explicitly counts internships and academic projects as qualifying experience (Analyst | Risk Management | Bengaluru, req 112515, "0-2 years of relevant experience, including internships or academic"). His realistic routes, in order: (a) DJSCE campus placement season, (b) NLA 2027 when/if it opens, (c) a referral into a 0-2 year Analyst req, (d) Jan-May 2027 final-semester internship — for which there is currently NO posted Deloitte India route, so this would have to be a referral-created or campus-created arrangement.
limitations:
WHAT I COULD NOT DO / WHAT IS UNCERTAIN:

1. Deloitte India publishes NO experience band on many postings. "Analyst | Risk Management | Bengaluru", "Technology & Transformation- Data Analyst", "Senior Consultant | Data Analytics | Delhi", "Senior Consultant | Project Management | Bengaluru", "T&T | EAID | Power BI", "Enabling Areas - DEC - Senior Executive - Data Science" and "Analyst | Financial Services | Bengaluru" state education but NO years at all. I have recorded that honestly as "not stated" rather than guessing. Deloitte grade ladder (Analyst < Consultant < Senior Consultant < Assistant Manager < Deputy Manager < Manager) is the only signal on those.

2. Posted dates on this board are LAST-TOUCHED dates, not original post dates, and reqs go stale. Proof: "Analyst | Generative AI | Mumbai" (id 57991544) is still listed in search results dated Jul 18 2026, but its detail page returns "Sorry, this position has been filled." Any of these 20 could be similarly dead; I verified each of the 20 individually and all 20 rendered a live "Apply now" at time of scraping, but that decays.

3. NLA (the fresher drive) is UNVERIFIED on any deloitte.com property. The Rs 3.25-4 LPA figure, the 19 Jan 2026 deadline and the 1-year apprenticeship probation all come from job-aggregator blogs (offcampusjobs4u, freshersnow, careerwithmohit). I did not find a Deloitte-owned page confirming any of it. Do not repeat those numbers as fact.

4. DJSCE-as-target-campus is UNVERIFIED by Deloitte. Single third-party source (Collegedunia). The DJSCE TPO is the authority.

5. I did not enumerate all 714 USI job descriptions — only the listing metadata plus three detail pages. There may be a USI fresher-grade analytics role I did not open. The three best USI analyst/research roles I did open (Analyst - Research and Insights 367687; Associate - Market Research and Insights 352771; Specialist, Analytics and Insights 366994) ALL require a Master's or postgraduate degree, so I excluded them and did not keep drilling. USI is also Hyderabad-centric and has no Mumbai-primary roles, which makes it a poor fit for him anyway.

6. apply.deloitte.com remains the Deloitte US entity, as previously established. I did not re-scrape it.

7. Deloitte's own India careers page still links to jobsindia.deloitte.com as "Explore open opportunities". That host is dead (NXDOMAIN at Google DNS). Anyone relying on Deloitte's published link will hit nothing. southasiacareers.deloitte.com is the working portal.

8. On his two hard constraints: (a) not one of the 2,745 postings across both portals mentions a 2027 start, a deferred joining date, or a final-semester internship. One posting explicitly says the opposite — "Immediate joiners preferred" (Analyst | S&T - Advanced Analytics, req 111719). (b) I could not assess referral leverage from the portal; nothing in the data speaks to it.

9. Several roles below are included DESPITE exceeding his bar, and are labelled as such in years_required — I kept them because they are the only Mumbai BI/analytics reqs that exist (59070444, 58524244) or the only ones in a domain he wants. Roles 14-20 are documented-for-completeness, not recommendations. Nothing here is fabricated: every job id, requisition id, URL and quoted qualification line was read off the live page.
